newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Afghan man for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Afghan man for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded an Afghan man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, raising to 51 the number of executions this year in the country.

A Saudi Interior Ministry statement carried by the official news agency SPA said the man was executed in the Red Sea city of Jeddah after being found guilty of smuggling an unspecified amount of heroin into the country.
Conservative Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists. It executed a total of 68 people in 1996.
